clue.text: In local speech, face English court

parts.note: the face of a clock or watch is its dial

explanation.surface: Someone talking in a regional accent puts on a brave face before an English court.
explanation.definitionFit: A dialect is the regional variety of a language, the way people talk in one particular area.

clue.text: Belittling edgy orator cruelly

indicators.note: cruelly suggests the edgy orator is treated harshly and twisted into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A nervous public speaker is mocked harshly.
explanation.definitionFit: Derogatory remarks disparage or show a low opinion of someone, making them seem less.

clue.text: Mountain area — it's essential to plan descent

indicators.note: it's essential to says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Climbing advice: in high country, plan your way down carefully.
explanation.definitionFit: The Andes is the long South American mountain range running down the western side of the continent.

clue.text: Leader potentially real idiot

indicators.note: potentially says real idiot could become something else once its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone in charge may turn out to be a genuine fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A leader in British newspapers is the editorial, the article giving the paper's own opinion.

clue.text: Criminal steals decorative item

indicators.note: criminal suggests the letters of steals are treated wrongly and rearranged

explanation.surface: A thief makes off with an ornament.
explanation.definitionFit: A tassel is a tuft of hanging threads used as an ornament on cushions, curtains or caps.

clue.text: Select tool

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a pointed implement for breaking ground or ice

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a verb meaning to choose and also a noun for a digging implement with a pointed head.

clue.text: Expected publicity people to include note

indicators.note: to include says the publicity people take the note inside them

parts.note: PR stands for public relations, the publicity trade
A is one of the musical notes

explanation.surface: The press team were bound to slip a memo in.
explanation.definitionFit: Par is the normal or standard level, as in up to par or par for the course.

clue.text: Taxi home extremely efficient for ministers

parts.note: a cab is a taxi
in means at home, as in staying in

indicators.note: extremely says to take only the outer letters of efficient

parts.note: first and last letters of efficient

explanation.surface: A taxi delivers government ministers home with great efficiency.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cabinet is the body of senior government ministers who decide policy together.

clue.text: Bring back the German wine

indicators.note: bring back tells us to turn the German article round so it reads from right to left

parts.note: der is a German word for the

explanation.surface: An instruction to bring back a German wine, as if returning a bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: Red is a colour of wine, used on its own as a noun for a glass or bottle of it.

clue.text: Perhaps sign one's name on fashionable cradle in southeast

parts.note: in means fashionable, as in the in thing

indicators.note: in says the cradle goes inside the abbreviation for southeast

parts.note: SE is the compass abbreviation for southeast
a crib is a baby's cot or cradle

explanation.surface: Someone autographs a trendy baby's cot somewhere in the south-east of England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' marks signing a name as just one example of the answer, which covers any writing or carving on a surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To write letters on a surface, such as signing a book or engraving a name, is one example of the verb.

clue.text: Posted a second time, intended to be heard, leading to bitterness

parts.note: re-sent means sent again, posted once more

indicators.note: to be heard says the word for intended is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: meant means intended

explanation.surface: A letter mailed twice, with deliberate intent, causes ill feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Resentment is bitter indignation at being treated unfairly, a lingering grudge.

clue.text: Initially growing up seemed time of great enjoyment

indicators.note: initially says to take the opening letter of each of the words that follow

parts.note: first letter of growing
first letter of up
first letter of seemed
first letter of time
first letter of of

explanation.surface: Looking back, a childhood seemed a period of great fun.
explanation.definitionFit: Gusto is zest or relish, the hearty enjoyment with which someone does something.

clue.text: In from France, temporary accommodation finally available, it's agreed

parts.note: en is the French word for in
a tent gives shelter for a short stay, as when camping

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word available

parts.note: last letter of available

explanation.surface: A traveller from France finds camping space free at last and confirms the arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: An entente is a friendly understanding between nations, something both sides have settled on by accord.

clue.text: What bride brings — exactly right note, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the words before are spoken aloud to sound like the answer

parts.note: true means exactly right, and so (soh) is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A wedding scene where the bride hits a perfectly tuned note.
explanation.definitionFit: A trousseau is the clothes and linen a bride collects for her married life.

clue.text: On return determined to hold pub game

indicators.note: on return says the whole built word is read backwards
to hold says the word for determined wraps round the pub

parts.note: set means determined, as in set on winning
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: Back home, someone insists on stopping at the pub for a game.
explanation.walkthrough: SET holding INN gives SINNET, which read backwards spells the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennis is a racket sport, a game played across a net by two or four players.

clue.text: One v all represented in creative work?

indicators.note: represented means re-presented, the letters of one v all set out again in another order

explanation.surface: A tale of one person against everyone shown in an imaginative piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A novella is a short novel, a piece of fiction, so an example of imaginative writing.

clue.text: Feel disgust for foreign article about curse

indicators.note: about says the foreign article goes round the curse

parts.note: le is the French masculine article, the
an oath is a swear word or curse

explanation.surface: Someone hates a piece written abroad about swearing.
explanation.definitionFit: To loathe something is to detest it intensely, to regard it with revulsion.

clue.text: Final month supported by a politician — leave quickly

indicators.note: in a down clue, supported by puts the month on top of what follows

parts.note: DEC is the abbreviation for December, the last month of the year
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: In December, backed by an MP, someone quits in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: To decamp is to depart suddenly or secretly, like breaking camp and leaving.

clue.text: Move around centre — see resistance develop gradually

parts.note: R is the symbol for electrical resistance
to evolve is to develop step by step over time

explanation.surface: An instruction to watch opposition grow slowly round a central point.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' is a link here, as in 'note that'.
explanation.definitionFit: To revolve is to turn or rotate about an axis or a central point, like a wheel.

clue.text: Encourage team's first burst of activity

parts.note: to spur someone on is to encourage them

indicators.note: first picks out the opening letter of the word team's

parts.note: first letter of team's

explanation.surface: A coach urges the side on, and the leading player responds with a sudden effort.
explanation.definitionFit: A spurt is a short sudden increase of effort or speed, as in a spurt of energy.

clue.text: Practice in America over long time

indicators.note: in a down clue, over puts US above the long time

parts.note: US is the United States
an age is a very long time

explanation.surface: A custom in the States that has lasted for years.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage is habitual practice, the customary way of doing something.

clue.text: Lag pipes faultily — failure to meet target

indicators.note: faultily says the letters of lag pipes are set out wrongly, in a new order

explanation.surface: A plumber insulates the pipes badly and so misses the deadline.
explanation.definitionFit: Slippage is a shortfall against a plan or a schedule falling behind its intended date.

clue.text: Play on words at the outset piquing global body

indicators.note: at the outset says to take only the opening letter of piquing

parts.note: first letter of piquing
the UN, the United Nations, is a worldwide organisation

explanation.surface: A witty joke at the start annoys the United Nations.
explanation.definitionFit: A pun is a joke exploiting a word's double meaning or similar sound.

clue.text: Abolish some tax exemptions

indicators.note: some means only part of the words tax exemptions is used, a run of letters within them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of tax into the start of exemptions

explanation.surface: A government proposes to scrap a few of its tax breaks.
explanation.definitionFit: To axe a scheme or job is to cut it or get rid of it altogether, as in budget cuts.

clue.text: Deal won oddly early in morning?

indicators.note: oddly says to take the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of deal won

explanation.surface: A card player wins a hand surprisingly in the small hours.
explanation.definitionFit: Dawn is daybreak, the first light at the start of the day, hence the question mark for a definition by description.

clue.text: Showing good judgment in point about discourteous knight

indicators.note: about says the abbreviation for point goes round the other pieces

parts.note: rude means discourteous
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A sensible remark points out that a knight was impolite.
explanation.definitionFit: A prudent person acts with care and foresight, weighing consequences sensibly.
